entities.name: STAT3
observations: STAT3 activation in hepatic stellate cells increases or sustains TGF-β1-associated profibrogenic signaling and extracellular-matrix production.
HSC-selective STAT3 loss reduces susceptibility to fibrosis in cholestatic and hepatotoxic injury models.

entities.name: TGF-β1
observations: TGF-β1 is functionally amplified by STAT3 activation in hepatic stellate cells and drives profibrogenic and anti-apoptotic responses through cooperation with STAT3 and Smad signaling.

entities.name: Hepatic stellate cells
observations: STAT3 activation promotes HSC activation, survival, α-SMA, collagen I/Col1a1, and TIMP1; STAT3 inhibition reduces TGF-β1-associated HSC responses.

entities.name: Liver fibrosis
observations: STAT3 activation in HSCs is associated with increased collagen deposition and fibrosis; genetic or pharmacologic STAT3 inhibition attenuates fibrosis in experimental models.

entities.name: Liver injury
observations: HSC STAT3-dependent fibrogenic signaling worsens chronic injury-associated fibrosis in bile-duct ligation, CCl4, TAA, and DEN models; effects of STAT3 are cell-type dependent.

entities.name: PMID:25092172
observations: In chronic hepatitis B tissue and DEN-fibrotic rats, STAT3 and TGF-β1 increased with fibrosis; STAT3 knockdown or JAK2 inhibition reduced TGF-β1 and weakened TGF-β1 profibrogenic effects in HSCs.

entities.name: PMID:22687286
observations: IL-17 induced type-I collagen in HSCs through STAT3; HSC STAT3 deletion reduced fibrosis susceptibility in bile-duct-ligation and CCl4 injury models.

entities.name: PMID:30935693
observations: STAT3 dimerization inhibition reduced nuclear STAT3, Col1a1, α-SMA, TGF-β1/IL-6-induced HSC activation, and experimental TAA/CCl4 fibrosis.

entities.name: PMID:30206312
observations: S3I-201 reduced HSC activation markers, TGFβ1/TGFβRII expression, TGF-β1-induced Smad2/3 phosphorylation, and CCl4 fibrosis.
